steps.en: Install a release build for your OS
steps.zh: 装上对应系统的发布版

steps.en: Open an IDML file exported from InDesign
steps.zh: 打开一份从 InDesign 导出的 IDML

steps.en: Rebuilds spreads, parent pages, styles, swatches and threaded stories as an editable document
steps.zh: 还原跨页、主页、样式、色板和串接文章，成为可编辑文档

steps.en: Edit with InDesign's tools, panels and shortcuts
steps.zh: 用 InDesign 那套工具、面板和快捷键排版

steps.en: Recomposes every paragraph with a Knuth–Plass composer and hyphenation
steps.zh: 用 Knuth–Plass 排版器和断字词典重排每一段

steps.en: Export the print PDF, or IDML back to InDesign
steps.zh: 导出印刷 PDF，或导回 InDesign 的 IDML
steps.code: File › Export PDF… · File → Export IDML…

steps.en: Writes real text with embedded font subsets, CMYK and spot inks, bleed and marks
steps.zh: 写出真文字、内嵌字体子集、CMYK 与专色、出血和裁切标记

value.en: You lay out and hand off print pages without an InDesign seat, a licence server or a cloud account
value.zh: 不用 InDesign 席位、授权服务器和云账号，也能排版并交付印刷页面

sources: README.md: Quick start, Downloads (Windows/macOS file names), Why DesignCraft (composer, hyphenation, IDML)
